title_en: Addition within 10: Ten Little Ducks Quack Quack
source_file: 10以内加法：十只小鸭嘎嘎嘎（5-8岁）.pptx
full_text_zh:
[P1] 数学来了！
学会10以内的加法运算
10以内加法
十只小鸭嘎嘎嘎
钟林姣 文 陈楠 绘
金盾出版社

[P2] 早上，鸭妈妈要去集市里买东西，不方便带着十只鸭宝宝。邻居鸡太太很热心，她愿意帮鸭妈妈照看鸭宝宝们。
鸡太太把鸭宝宝们带到自己家里。十只鸭宝宝光在沙发上跳来跳去，然后开始抢东西，才一会儿的时间，就把鸡太太的家弄得乱七八糟了。

[P3] 这样可不行，鸡太太把鸭宝宝们集合起来，让他们围成一个
圈——她要给小家伙们讲故事。

负责的鸡太太，随时注意鸭宝宝们都在不在。
来，先点个名。

嘎嘎嘎

“鸭老大。”“嘎嘎嘎。”“鸭老二。”“嘎嘎嘎。”
“鸭老三。”“嘎嘎嘎。”“鸭老四。”“嘎嘎嘎。”
“鸭老五。”“嘎嘎嘎。”“鸭老六。”“嘎嘎嘎。”
“鸭小七。”“嘎嘎嘎。”
“鸭小八。”“嘎嘎嘎。”
“鸭小九。”“嘎嘎嘎。”
“鸭小十。”“嘎嘎嘎。”
十只鸭宝宝，一只都不少。

[P4] 鸡太太开始讲故事了。
嘎嘎嘎——
鸭宝宝们喜欢听故事。
“从前，有一个农夫……”
嘎嘎嘎——
十只鸭宝宝不喜欢听农夫的故事。
鸭宝宝们喜欢听什么故事呢？
一只鸭宝宝喜欢听“小红帽”的
故事，九只鸭宝宝喜欢听“白雪公主”
的故事。一只鸭宝宝加九只鸭宝宝，
正好是十只鸭宝宝。

[P5] 那就先讲白雪公主的故事：“很久很久以前，有一个非常美丽的小公主，她的皮肤像雪一样白，她的头发像乌木那样黑，她的嘴唇像玫瑰花瓣那样红，大家都叫她白雪公主。虽然白雪公主长得很漂亮，但是她的心肠坏透了……”
嘎嘎嘎——
鸭妈妈讲的白雪公主的故事不是这样的。
真难为情，鸡太太好久好久没看故事书了，她记不清白雪公主的故事了。
嘎嘎嘎——
鸭宝宝们不想听故事了。

[P6] 两只鸭宝宝要喝水，八只鸭宝宝要上厕所。两只鸭宝宝加八只鸭宝宝，正好是十只鸭宝宝。

嘎嘎嘎——
鸭宝宝们去院子里玩。
四只鸭宝宝跳绳，六只鸭宝宝拍球。四只鸭宝宝加六只鸭宝宝，正好是十只鸭宝宝。

嘎嘎嘎——
鸭宝宝们要画画。
三只鸭宝宝画了大树，七只鸭宝宝画了太阳。三只鸭宝宝加七只鸭宝宝，正好是十只鸭宝宝。

嘎嘎嘎——
鸭宝宝们准备游泳。
五只鸭宝宝在池塘的左边，五只鸭宝宝在池塘的右边。五只鸭宝宝加五只鸭宝宝，正好是十只鸭宝宝。

[P7] 嘎嘎嘎——
鸭宝宝们在玩气球。
六只鸭宝宝的气球是鸭子形状，四只鸭宝宝的气球是小鸡形状的。六
只鸭宝宝加四只鸭宝宝，正好是十只鸭宝宝。
嘎嘎嘎——
鸭宝宝们还要喝牛奶。
八只鸭宝宝用蓝色的杯子喝牛奶，两只鸭宝宝用绿色的杯子喝
牛奶。八只鸭宝宝加两只鸭宝宝，正好是十只鸭宝宝。
嘎嘎嘎——
鸭宝宝们肚子饿了。
七只鸭宝宝吃的是三角形蛋糕，三只鸭宝宝吃的是圆圆的面包。七只鸭宝宝加三只鸭宝宝，正好是十只鸭宝宝。
嘎嘎嘎——
鸭宝宝们要睡午睡了。
九只鸭宝宝在床上睡着了，一只鸭宝宝在地毯上翻跟头。喂，
鸭小十，不睡觉可不行，会影响其他鸭宝宝的。

[P8] 趁鸭宝宝们正在午睡，鸡太太得赶紧去收拾乱糟糟的屋子，没时间在房间里看着鸭小十。
那就把鸭小十带在身边吧！只有这样，鸡太太才能放心。

鸡太太刚收拾好屋子，鸭宝宝们都醒了，鸭妈妈也正好回来了。她来接十只鸭宝宝回家啦。
鸭宝宝们开心地围着妈妈。
“我们在鸡太太这里玩得很开心。”
鸭妈妈连忙说：“实在太谢谢了，鸡太太。”
“这没什么，鸭宝宝们非常可爱。”

[P9] 鸭宝宝们要回家了，负责任的鸡太太，要点一点鸭宝宝们都在不在。
“一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八、九——”
天哪，只有九只鸭宝宝，还有一只鸭宝宝去哪里了？

“嘎嘎嘎——”
鸡太太的围裙大口袋里好像有声音。
哦，是的，鸡太太把鸭小十放在围裙
口袋里了。
“嘎嘎嘎——”

现在没错啦，九只
鸭宝宝加一只鸭宝宝，
正好是十只鸭宝宝。

[P10] 鸭妈妈买了好多东西回来，每种东西的数量都是十，请你在每一组东西的下面贴上对应数量的“●”。
full_text_en:
[P1] Math is here!
Learn addition within 10
Addition within 10
Ten Little Ducks Quack Quack
Written by Zhong Linjiao, Illustrated by Chen Nan
Jin Dun Publishing House

[P2] In the morning, Duck Mommy was going to the market to buy things, and it was inconvenient to bring along her ten ducklings. Neighbor Chicken Mommy was very kind-hearted and offered to help Duck Mommy look after the ducklings.
Chicken Mommy took the ducklings to her own home. The ten ducklings jumped around on the sofa, then started fighting over things. In just a little while, they turned Chicken Mommy's house into a mess.

[P3] This won't do. Mrs. Chicken gathers the ducklings and has them form a circle—she's going to tell them a story.

Responsible Mrs. Chicken keeps an eye on the ducklings to make sure they're all present.
Alright, let's take a roll call.

Quack quack quack

"Duckling One." "Quack quack quack." "Duckling Two." "Quack quack quack."
"Duckling Three." "Quack quack quack." "Duckling Four." "Quack quack quack."
"Duckling Five." "Quack quack quack." "Duckling Six." "Quack quack quack."
"Duckling Seven." "Quack quack quack."
"Duckling Eight." "Quack quack quack."
"Duckling Nine." "Quack quack quack."
"Duckling Ten." "Quack quack quack."
All ten ducklings are here, not one missing.

[P4] Mrs. Chicken began telling a story.
Quack quack quack——
The ducklings like to listen to stories.
"Once upon a time, there was a farmer..."
Quack quack quack——
Ten ducklings don't like to hear the farmer's story.
What story do the ducklings like to hear?
One duckling likes to hear the story of "Little Red Riding Hood",
and nine ducklings like to hear the story of "Snow White".
One duckling plus nine ducklings
is exactly ten ducklings.

[P5] Let's start with the story of Snow White: 'A long, long time ago, there was a very beautiful little princess. Her skin was as white as snow, her hair as black as ebony, and her lips as red as rose petals. Everyone called her Snow White. Although Snow White was very beautiful, her heart was rotten to the core...'
Quack quack quack——
The story of Snow White told by Duck Mommy isn't like that.
How embarrassing! Chicken Lady hasn't read a storybook for a long, long time. She can't remember the story of Snow White.
Quack quack quack——
The ducklings don't want to hear the story anymore.

[P6] Two ducklings want to drink water, eight ducklings want to go to the toilet. Two ducklings plus eight ducklings equals ten ducklings.

Quack quack quack—
The ducklings go to play in the yard.
Four ducklings jump rope, six ducklings play ball. Four ducklings plus six ducklings equals ten ducklings.

Quack quack quack—
The ducklings want to draw.
Three ducklings draw a big tree, seven ducklings draw the sun. Three ducklings plus seven ducklings equals ten ducklings.

Quack quack quack—
The ducklings are getting ready to swim.
Five ducklings are on the left side of the pond, five ducklings are on the right side. Five ducklings plus five ducklings equals ten ducklings.

[P7] Quack quack quack——
The ducklings are playing with balloons.
Six ducklings have duck-shaped balloons, and four ducklings have chick-shaped balloons. Six ducklings plus four ducklings equals ten ducklings.
Quack quack quack——
The ducklings want to drink milk.
Eight ducklings drink milk from blue cups, and two ducklings drink milk from green cups. Eight ducklings plus two ducklings equals ten ducklings.
Quack quack quack——
The ducklings are hungry.
Seven ducklings eat triangular cakes, and three ducklings eat round buns. Seven ducklings plus three ducklings equals ten ducklings.
Quack quack quack——
The ducklings are going to take a nap.
Nine ducklings are sleeping in beds, and one duckling is doing somersaults on the rug. Hey, Duckling Ten, you can't stay awake, it will affect the other ducklings.

[P8] While the ducklings were napping, Mrs. Chicken had to hurry and clean up the messy house. She didn’t have time to watch Duckling Ten in the room.
So she took Duckling Ten with her! Only then could Mrs. Chicken feel at ease.

Just as Mrs. Chicken finished cleaning, the ducklings woke up, and Duckling Mom arrived right on time. She came to pick up the ten ducklings.
The ducklings happily gathered around their mom.
“We had a great time at Mrs. Chicken’s!”
Duckling Mom hurriedly said, “Thank you so much, Mrs. Chicken.”
“It’s nothing, the ducklings are so adorable.”

[P9] The ducklings were going home, and responsible Mrs. Chicken was checking to make sure all the ducklings were present.
“One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine—”
Oh my, there are only nine ducklings. Where did the tenth duckling go?

“Quack quack quack—”
There seems to be a sound coming from Mrs. Chicken’s big apron pocket.
Oh, yes! Mrs. Chicken had put Duckling Ten in her apron pocket.
“Quack quack quack—”

Now it’s correct. Nine ducklings plus one duckling equals exactly ten ducklings.

[P10] Duck Mom bought a lot of things back, and the quantity of each item is ten. Please stick the corresponding number of "●" below each group of items.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《10以内加法》的封面，标题为《十只小鸭嘎嘎嘎》，作者为钟林姣，绘者为陈楠，由金盾出版社出版。画面中有三只小鸭，其中两只正合力拉扯一个绿色的袋子。
[P2] 鸭妈妈要去集市买东西，将十只鸭宝宝托付给热心的邻居鸡太太照看。鸡太太带鸭宝宝们回家后，它们在沙发上跳来跳去并抢东西，很快就把家里弄得乱七八糟。
[P3] 鸡太太将十只鸭宝宝集合起来，准备给他们讲故事，并通过点名确认所有鸭宝宝都在场。
[P4] 鸡太太开始给十只鸭宝宝讲故事，但它们不喜欢听农夫的故事。于是鸡太太询问它们喜欢什么故事，发现一只喜欢听《小红帽》，九只喜欢听《白雪公主》，通过加法1+9=10，确认所有鸭宝宝都在场。
[P5] 鸡太太试图给鸭宝宝们讲白雪公主的故事，但因记不清情节而讲错了，导致鸭宝宝们不感兴趣并表示不想再听故事。
[P6] 本页通过四个场景展示十只鸭宝宝的分组活动，分别用加法算式（2+8、4+6、3+7、5+5）说明总数始终为十，帮助儿童理解10以内的加法概念。
[P7] 本页通过四个场景展示十只鸭宝宝的分组活动：玩气球（6+4）、喝牛奶（8+2）、吃点心（7+3）和午睡（9+1），每个场景都用加法算式说明总数始终为十，帮助儿童理解10以内的加法概念。
[P8] 鸡太太趁鸭宝宝们午睡时打扫屋子，并带着鸭小十以防万一。打扫完毕后，鸭妈妈前来接回所有鸭宝宝，鸭宝宝们开心地向鸡太太道谢，鸡太太也称赞它们可爱。
[P9] 鸭宝宝们准备回家，鸡太太清点人数时发现少了一只，后来发现鸭小十被藏在她的围裙口袋里，最终确认十只鸭宝宝全部到齐。
[P10] 本页展示鸭妈妈买回的多种物品，每种物品数量均为十，要求读者在每组物品下方贴上对应数量的圆点，旨在通过实物计数练习巩固数字10的概念。
